description: This file implements an autotuning module for a PID controller, specifically the 'pid_auto_tune.cpp' source code. It includes functions for controlling the autotuning process, estimating PID parameters, and managing the autotuning state machine, largely based on relay feedback methods and specific tuning rules.

classes.name: PID_AutoTune
classes.description: A class implementing the auto-tuning logic for a PID controller, including methods for runtime operation, parameter estimation, and state management.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Stops the autotuning process by setting its state to OFF.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal variables to their initial state and configuration.

methods.name: SetLookbackSec
methods.description: Configures the lookback period for process input data.

methods.name: fastArcTan
methods.description: Provides an efficient approximation of arctangent.

methods.name: calculatePhaseLag
methods.description: Calculates the phase lag based on the induced amplitude.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the auto-tuner and logs the change.

methods.name: setPeakType
methods.description: Sets the current peak type (maximum or minimum) and logs.

methods.name: Runtime
methods.description: Main function to run the autotuning process; returns true when tuning is completed or failed.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the output value during autotuning.

methods.name: SetOutputStep
methods.description: Sets the step size for output during autotuning.

methods.name: GetOutputStep
methods.description: Retrieves the current output step size.

methods.name: SetControlType
methods.description: Configures the auto-tuning rule to use.
